persona: First-generation learner with limited professional networks
description: A learner who may have limited access to professional mentors, career guidance, industry knowledge, and professional networks.
primary_challenge: Uncertainty about career options, required skills, learning pathways, professional networking, and how to become employment-ready.
goal: Help the learner identify a realistic career destination and create an achievable pathway from aspiration to employment.
success_outcome: The learner has a realistic target role, understands existing and missing skills, follows a personalized learning plan, builds proof of learning, develops professional connections, and knows the next career action.
